versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "haircut" skill for analyzing and reducing configuration bloat in coding agents.
- Scans and measures agent loads (instructions, memory, servers, hooks, skills, plugins, etc.) and reports token costs from real transcript data.
- Identifies biggest sources of config overhead and guides users through decisions to park, trim, or keep items, including safe handling of credentials.
- Supports both command-line and browser-based review and decision workflows, with explicit receipts and one-command undo for any change.
- No deletions—everything removed is safely parked for recovery, and team/shared files receive special caution.
